description: Codemode tool for oh-my-pi: run JS against host tools in a QuickJS sandbox, plus an experimental durable journal (parked on the omp 18.12.6 platform wall).
name: omp-codemode

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/omp-codemode.js --target bun && bun build node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-codemode/dist/runtime/worker.js --outfile dist/pi-worker.js --target bun
scripts.test: bun test/smoke-codemode.ts && bun test/smoke-bundle.ts && (bun test/smoke-durable.ts A; bun test/smoke-durable.ts B)
